title: Odour-specific associative learning on the connectome's mushroom body: a sparse Kenyon-cell code and a three-factor, synapse-specific rule, against fixed weights, the merged rule, a dopamine lesion, shuffled rewards, rewired PN-KC wiring and the repository's mushroom-body rate model
preregistration: Written before any learning run of this file. The rule and its constants, the protocol, the odours (development by hand; held-out by the seeded draw below, done once and written here), the arms and the criteria are fixed here. The only quantity set from data is the dopamine threshold, by the calibration rule below, on development odours and seeds only, before any learning run. Development runs may repeat while code changes; the held-out split runs once, from a clean commit, and is reported whatever it shows. No criterion changes after a result is seen.

representation.what: sparse: the Kenyon-cell code selected by experiments/mb-representation-al-v783.json (antennal-lobe local neurons' excitatory gain x KC threshold, chosen for the least A/B overlap). thr-only: mb-representation-v783's selection (KC threshold x3, sparse but as overlapping as before). dense: Shiu et al.'s weights as they are.

rule_v2.status: model: every constant is ours, chosen before any run, none fitted
rule_v2.basis: Depression of KC-to-MBON synapses needs KC activity paired with dopamine (Hige et al. 2015, Neuron 88:985-998, doi:10.1016/j.neuron.2015.11.003; Cohn et al. 2015, Cell 163:1742-1755, doi:10.1016/j.cell.2015.11.019); the order of KC activity and dopamine sets its sign and a trace links them over seconds (Handler et al. 2019, Cell 178:60-75, doi:10.1016/j.cell.2019.05.040); unreinforced re-exposure extinguishes a memory (Felsenberg et al. 2017, Nature 544:240-244, doi:10.1038/nature21716; Felsenberg et al. 2018, Cell 175:709-722, doi:10.1016/j.cell.2018.08.021). The per-synapse Rescorla-Wagner form, the threshold and the bounded weight are ours (status model).

protocol.odour_drive_note: Every odour's ORNs together fire as many spikes as development odour A's do at 80 Hz (its 222 ORNs), because the held-out glomeruli have about half as many ORNs; capped at 200 Hz. Ours.
protocol.readout: spikes of the readout MBONs (those receiving at least 5 synapses from some PAM DAN) summed over a 500 ms test trial, plasticity off; the brain starts each trial from rest
protocol.reward: PAM DANs driven at reward_rate_hz (all of them) over the reward window

li_acq.what: A's response after acquisition relative to before, minus B's: negative when the paired odour's MBON response fell more (learning)

b_change.what: B's relative change after acquisition: near 0 when the unpaired odour is spared

li_ret.what: the same after the distractor odour C was presented, unrewarded, 4 times

recovery.what: A's response after 6 unrewarded A trials minus after acquisition: positive when extinction restored it

li_rev.what: after B was rewarded and A not: positive when B's response now fell more than A's

generalization.what: the change in the response to Asim, which shares two of A's three glomeruli

odours.note: Abstract odours: the ORNs of three glomeruli each, both sides. No chemical identity or valence is claimed. Asim shares two of A's glomeruli.
odours.heldout_draw: From the ORN types with at least 30 neurons in FlyWire's annotations, less the 10 glomeruli development uses (24 left, sorted by name): numpy default_rng(3700002).permutation; H1 takes A = perm[0:3], B = perm[3:6], Asim = A[0:2] + perm[6], C = perm[7:10]; H2 the same from perm[10:20]. Done once, before any run, and written below.

calibration.rule: theta_hz = the midpoint of (a) the 0.999 quantile of the compartment dopamine rate over all 10 ms bins of unrewarded test-length trials and (b) the median of the same over rewarded ones; development odours A and B, development seeds, the selected representation; before any learning run

arms.what: the merged rule on the merged representation: the existing mechanism

arms.name: v1-sparse
arms.what: the merged rule on the sparse code

arms.name: v2
arms.what: the improved rule on the sparse code

arms.name: v2-dense
arms.what: the improved rule without the sparse code

arms.name: v2-thr-only
arms.what: the improved rule on a code made sparse by the KC threshold alone, without the antennal-lobe change

arms.name: v2-no-threshold
arms.what: every PAM spike counts as reward (theta 0)

arms.name: v2-dan-silenced
arms.what: PAM DANs silenced and their output blocked

arms.name: v2-reward-shuffled
arms.what: each plastic phase's rewards reassigned to random trials of that phase

arms.name: v2-pnkc-shuffled
arms.what: PN->KC synapses' targets permuted among KCs (each PN's out-degree and each KC's in-degree kept): disrupted connectivity

arms.name: v2-trace-no-trace
arms.what: the same with the eligibility trace removed (1 ms)

echo_mb.what: The repository's mushroom-body rate model (src/bethesda/fly/mushroomBody/circuit.ts, Bennett, Philippides & Nowotny 2021), run by scripts/echo-neural-plasticity.ts --schedule v2 on the standard schedule (the run refuses its result if the schedules differ). Arms: as-is, and with the DANs' output blocked in unrewarded trials. Its indices are differences on its own prediction scale, which rises with reward; reported, not judged.
